name: Shining Smite

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

summary: Right after a melee hit: an extra 2d6 Radiant; the target glows, attacks against it have Advantage and it can't hide in Invisibility.
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike. The target takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, it sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it gains no benefit from the Invisible condition. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2.
